params.prompt: This is the WIND-BLOWN KEYFRAME for animating the exact reference game title. Preserve the reference pixel illustration, camera, building, stairs, books, all three creatures, left-side menu space, and protagonist position EXACTLY. Edit ONLY the hanging lower coat tails and ponytail. A visible wind blows from left to right: lift both split sage-lined lower hanbok coat panels strongly to the RIGHT, with their tips 80 screen pixels right and 35 screen pixels UP relative to the reference, exposing a visibly larger sage lining surface. The green coat hem silhouette must be substantially DIFFERENT from the reference, not copied. The black ponytail lifts 25px rightwards. Keep the round gold dragon on UPPER back, body, head, arms, talismans, feet and gourd in exactly the same positions. No new objects, no text, no new cape. Fine crisp pixel illustration, existing cream/ink/sage/gold palette, no blur or glow. One complete landscape frame, not a comparison or sprite sheet.

Animate a clear gentle gust of wind between these two matching pixel-art keyframes. Fixed camera. Start with coat tails down as in FIRST image; finish with existing split green-lined coat panels visibly blown to the RIGHT as in LAST image. The changing coat silhouette is the main motion and must travel smoothly all the way to the end reference pose. Ponytail and hanging gourd cord move with a little delay. Preserve character clothing, gold back dragon, position, body and feet. Architecture, stairs, books, background creatures and LEFT menu space stay stationary. No walking, attacks, talking, new objects, camera movement, blur, glow, flicker or audio. Crisp pixel illustration, same palette. This is a coat-motion transition, not a static image.

Animate the supplied Korean pixel-art game title illustration into an unmistakably MOVING six-second idle scene. The previous version was almost a still image; this revision MUST show visible CLOTH DISPLACEMENT. Locked camera, perfectly stationary architecture, shelves, lanterns and calm LEFT menu space. Preserve the exact black-haired protagonist, ink modern hanbok, cream collar, sage split coat lining, round gold dragon on the upper BACK, gourd and blank paper cards, and the three approved creatures. Feet, torso, shoulders and hands remain planted and fixed. No new cape, characters, weapons, text or objects.
PRIMARY MOTION: a steady gentle breeze lifts the two EXISTING long split hanbok coat panels away from the legs. Make the lower SAGE-LINED hem swing visibly 25–45 SCREEN PIXELS sideways at 1080p, then return. Perform a clear outward-and-back sway during seconds0–3 and another during3–6. The green inner coat panel should visibly change its outline against the stairs. The gold round dragon emblem on the UPPER BACK stays rigid and readable. Do not merely animate texture or lighting. The tied black ponytail and a few loose tips sway 10–16 pixels with a slight delay, and the sleeve cuff moves 6–10 pixels. The waist gourd cord has a tiny delayed swing. These are small natural garment motions relative to the figure, but clearly visible even when displayed at1280px width.
SECONDARY: a small, flat lavender mist curl drifts gently behind the character, without entering the left menu area. Creature bodies stay still, fox ears may move once subtly. No camera pan, zoom, shake, dolly, parallax or cut. No global image oscillation. No walking, attacks, facial talking, breathing scale deformation, blinking light, new particles or overlaid effects. Maintain fine pixel-illustration line art with crisp clusters, original palette and stable background, without motion blur, glow or smearing. Silent, no audio. Begin in the reference pose; aim to return to it at the end, but prioritize real visible coat and ponytail motion throughout the middle.
